items.title: Stronger Orders And Backlog Amid Softer Closings Could Be A Game Changer For PulteGroup (PHM)
items.summary: Earlier in the past quarter, PulteGroup reported second-quarter 2026 results with adjusted earnings and total revenue surpassing estimates, even as home sale revenues and deliveries fell year over year.
